posts.title: Tonight’s dinner is… Bistek
posts.description: Which is a Filipino dish of thinly sliced beef steak braised in soy sauce, some kind of citrus juice, garlic, ground black pepper, and onions. The citrus is supposed to be calamansi but I don’t have it so lemon it is And of course rice. I’m very tired because I didn’t get a lot of sleep and I didn’t take a nap but I had a really good time talking to some people I know and then of course I made dinner. Which is a good thing because all I’ve had today is coffee and bread which my stomach reminded me at 7:30.
